test_cases.name: CLI VPC service availability
test_cases.expected: Help output shows ListVpcs parameters, no USE_ERROR

test_cases.name: List VPCs live (v3, limit=3)
test_cases.expected: JSON with vpcs array; each vpc has id/name/cidr/status

test_cases.name: List VPCs live (v2, limit=2)
test_cases.expected: JSON with vpcs array including tenant_id field

test_cases.name: Filter VPCs by name (v3)
test_cases.expected: vpcs array filtered to matching VPC name

test_cases.name: Filter VPCs by enterprise project (all)
test_cases.expected: JSON with vpcs array (may be empty if no projects granted)

test_cases.name: SDK VPC client availability
test_cases.command: python3 -c "from huaweicloudsdkvpc.v3 import VpcClient; print('SDK OK')"

test_cases.name: SDK read-only list_vpcs (limit=1)
test_cases.command: python3 -c "from huaweicloudsdkvpc.v3 import VpcClient; print('SDK VpcClient importable')"

env_vars_required: HUAWEI_ACCESS_KEY/HUAWEI_SECRET_KEY or HWC_AK/HWC_SK, or KooCLI AKSK profile
notes: Read-only queries only. No create/update/delete operations.
